defects_repaired.name: singleton_wrong_bot
defects_repaired.fix: Enforced item.bot_id == bot_id check on all representative and constituent updates in validate_group_identity, preventing singletons from bypassing bot identity.

defects_repaired.name: later_group_collision_commits
defects_repaired.fix: Prevalidated all update groups up front prior to committing the first group in commit_prefix, preventing partial commits on batch identity collision.

defects_repaired.name: known_replay_rejected
defects_repaired.fix: Looked up inbox record via read_keys when update_id < current_watermark to admit matching known replay via zero-delta apply rather than rejecting.

defects_repaired.name: partial_bootstrap_cannot_resume
defects_repaired.fix: Intercepted db_already_exists error during initialize_store, inspecting metadata rows to idempotently complete initial bootstrap.

defects_repaired.name: other_worker_can_mark_sending
defects_repaired.fix: Read and verified durable auth/<request_id> row in commit_result, commit_sending, and commit_outcome, binding auth key in read_set assertions and enforcing matching worker and epoch.

defects_repaired.name: negative_generation_accepted
defects_repaired.fix: Enforced generation > 0 in decode_initialize_new_response, decode_read_keys_response, decode_read_inbox_index_response, and receipt_decoder.

defects_repaired.name: malformed_receipt_accepted
defects_repaired.fix: Enforced non-empty operation_id, valid 64-hex request_digest, generation > 0, valid JSON summary, and committed_utc_us > 0 in receipt_decoder.

defects_repaired.name: malformed_row_accepted
defects_repaired.fix: Validated every row decoded in decode_read_keys_response against validate_row_result, rejecting corrupt row states.

defects_repaired.name: error_reflects_private_marker
defects_repaired.fix: Filtered backend error strings through is_whitelisted_backend_error; unwhitelisted strings (e.g. SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_MARKER) map to 'unwhitelisted_backend_error'.

defects_repaired.name: invalid_state_panics
defects_repaired.fix: Eliminated all 7 panics across telegram_store.gleam, returning typed StoreInvariantError on invalid outbox/inbox states and invalid workers/epochs.

defects_repaired.name: absence_declared_without_quiescence
defects_repaired.fix: reconcile_uncertain defaults to writer_quiesced = False returning ReconciledUnknown('writer_quiescence_unproven'); ReconciledAbsent requires explicit quiescence proof.
